guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Sign Up at Yakkamon
guide.description: Create your account with an email address on the Yakkamon pre-registration page . No wallet is needed at this stage. Enter the referral code YAKKA-52UCFU during sign-up.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Nurture Your Egg Daily
guide.description: Tap your egg three times each day for +6 points. Daily streaks add bonuses, and a missed day resets the streak.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Discord and X
guide.description: Link your Discord and X accounts for +10 points each. Helpful posts in the Discord earn extra points through community reactions, and the weekly share quest pays +20 points per week once X is connected.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Link and Verify a Wallet
guide.description: Connect a wallet and sign a message to prove ownership for +10 points. A verified wallet is also required for the free mint whitelist, so complete this well before October 1, 2026.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer Friends
guide.description: Each verified friend who joins earns you +30 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint the Free Monster NFT on October 1
guide.description: Join the free mint of 10,000 Monster NFTs on Ronin using your verified wallet. It costs nothing beyond a small gas fee, is limited to one mint per trainer, and minting adds points to your leaderboard total.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint Your Yakkamon NFT
guide.description: Check which waves your Ronin wallet qualifies for on the whitelist checker Deposit 5 $FLOWER if you’re minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4 (see the $FLOWER deposit guide ) Connect your Ronin wallet to the Ronin Launchpad when your wave opens and mint, keeping some RON for gas
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
